routesToMount.note: Static routes /validate, /check-compatibility, /normalize, /stats, /domain/:domain must be declared BEFORE /:id — already ordered correctly inside the router file.

pagesToRegister.instruction: Add: import DesignBlueprintsPage from './pages/design-blueprints/index.tsx'; <Route path='/design-blueprints' component={DesignBlueprintsPage} />

sidebarItems.label: Blueprint Library
sidebarItems.instruction: Add a sidebar nav item under the 'Creative' section. Icon: Layers from lucide-react.

integrationOrder: 1. Team 24 executes integration/migrations/team-07.sql on dev DB
2. Team 24 mounts design-blueprints router in routes/index.ts
4. Team 24 adds Blueprint Library sidebar item in layout.tsx
5. Team 24 merges OpenAPI fragment into root openapi.yaml (optional — service functions as standalone)
knownRisks: In-process custom blueprint store resets on API server restart until DB migration is applied — built-ins are always available
Admin UI fetch calls use VITE_ADMIN_API_KEY — must be set for API calls to succeed
OpenAPI fragment uses operationId prefix 'listDesignBlueprints' etc — ensure no collision with existing operationIds
Blueprint dimensions use domain-native units (mm for interior/packaging, px for graphic_design/presentation) — zone bound checking is px-only
